authoring.author: claude (nassaukade-506 kit lane)
authoring.note: Nassaukade 152-145, west side, the row opposite houseboat berth Nassaukade 506 (De Clercqstraat corner to the bend at 145), 1898-1900. Measured on 80 px/m rectified crops of the 2024-11-21 panoramas with a metre ruler; wall colours are medians white-balanced (to a warm white #ebe5d5; the cast is golden-hour sun) against each front's own white dressings. Two oud-west library types (three-axis 148/147/146, two-axis balcony stack 149/145); 150 (stepped gable) and the corner 151-152 have their own designs.

notes: near-black painted brick (white-balanced wall median #524b3d on the 2024-11-21 crop); granite souterrain front and the arched door portal read as the stone plinth/stoop

Storey-3 arches (kit lane 2026-10-14): round relieving arches (rise half the span), springers 0.14 x 0.18 m at the arch feet, dark tympanum = wall x 0.72 (measured tympanum/wall luma 0.67-0.68 on this front), exported with the painted wall as a measured tint.

Heads (kit lane 2026-10-14): the sills climb in a 3.0 m pitch (2.89, 5.83, 8.83, 11.83 m) with heads at 5.0, 7.7, 10.7 and 13.57 m on the 80 px/m crop; storeyHeights (souterrain first) put the floors 0.3 m under the sills and headLines/windowHeights land the heads; the storey-3 arches spring 0.55 m over the heads (a dark lintel course between, springGap) at 14.12 m, crown 14.64 m.
